findings.title: A-02 has no runtime enforcement: MutationInterceptor context is write-only
findings.notes: 3D observation: MutationInterceptor's context is a single non-stacking variable and clearContext() nulls it, so a governed flag write nested inside another ActorEngine operation clears the outer context. Harmless today because nothing reads the context (this finding); it must become a stack before any enforcement is enabled. | MutationInterceptor now keeps a context stack; inner clear no longer de-authorizes the outer call. | Context stack; unbalanced clear is a no-op; blockNestedMutations preserved.
